title: רב פנחס ברי' דרב אמי

paragraphs: Rav Pinhas son of Rav Ammi. Zevahim 4a; Rav Ashi spoke to him there, Zevahim 7b:5. Rav Yeimar, or some say Marimar, said to Mar Zutra [the retrieved Bavli gives Marimar first]: ‘I happened to attend Rav Pinhas bar Ammi's lecture’; Pesahim 100a:2, at the beginning of Arvei Pesahim. Also Rav Pappa and Rav Huna bar Rav Yehoshua, Ketubbot 85a.
